## Purpose

List bounded pages of durable wait history for the current task, or for the named supervisor’s project. History includes resolved waits from earlier claims.

See [durable agent waits](../../guides/agent-waits.md) for examples, ownership,
deadline semantics, adapter availability, installation and rollback.

## Persistence and diagnostics

[WaitCommandsMixin](../../../src/commands/wait_commands.py) delegates to the
[wait query boundary](../../../src/database/queries/agent_wait_queries.py).
The `agent_waits` row and unique `wait_result` message survive daemon restart.
The four contracts do not launch or kill sessions, release capacity, or unpause
manual holds.

Rejected mutations return an explicit error such as `stale_claim`,
`wait.already_active`, `wait.idempotency_conflict`, `wait.invalid`, or
`out_of_scope`. Inspect the task's current claim and the wait with `aq wait show`
when diagnosing a rejected mutation. Exemptions are valid only for a live claim;
readable historical results confer no mutation authority.
